title: Of Chains and Gains: What Reinforcement Learning changes on Reasoning-based Image Quality Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.33203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the performance of large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches often attribute these gains to improved reasoning before scoring, supported by increasingly plausible Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, whether these gains exceed sampling effects and how they depend on explicit reasoning remain unclear. We rigorously investigate these questions through sampling-aware evaluation, controlled reasoning interventions, and shortcut experiments. We find that RL-trained models outperform base models under large-budget $\operatorname{max}_g@k$ evaluation, while improvements beyond averaging are concentrated in-distribution. RLVR produces chains that raise base-model performance when transplanted and improves scoring with the chain held fixed. Yet scoring becomes less dependent on the chain during inference, more clearly at 7B than at 32

translated_title: 链与收益：强化学习对基于推理的图像质量评估带来了什么改变
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已提升了大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像质量评估（IQA）任务上的性能。现有方法通常将这些收益归因于评分前推理能力的提升，其依据是日益合理的思维链。然而，这些收益是否超越了采样效应，以及它们如何依赖于显式推理，仍不清楚。我们通过采样感知评估、受控推理干预和捷径实验严谨地研究了这些问题。我们发现，在大预算 $\operatorname{max}_g@k$ 评估下，RL 训练的模型优于基础模型，而超出平均效果的改进集中在分布内。RLVR 生成的思维链在被移植到基础模型时能提升其性能，并且在固定思维链的情况下也能改善评分。然而在推理过程中，评分对思维链的依赖性逐渐降低，这种趋势在 7B 模型上比 32B 模型上更为明显。
tldr: 本文通过采样感知评估与受控推理干预严谨剖析了 RLVR 在图像质量评估中的真实收益，发现其改进超越采样效应但集中于分布内，且模型评分在推理时对思维链的依赖性逐渐减弱。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously dissects the gains of RLVR on reasoning-based image quality assessment through sampling-aware evaluation and controlled reasoning interventions, finding that improvements exceed sampling effects only in-distribution while models' scoring becomes increasingly independent of their Chain-of-Thought during inference.
